text:
tasha_cs: Quick smoke-check for BlueHaven priv/VPC onboarding before tomorrow's cutover. Checklist: egress for log-forwarder, IAM assume-role mapping, CMK access + rotation, and audit logs retention. Short replies plz.

ben_net: Network quick note: forwarder in private subnet -> NAT. Need three egress targets allowed: S3 VPCE, splunk.ingest.bluehaven.net (203.0.113.10), and telemetry.redwood.net. Recommend swapping S3 route to VPCE during cutover.

ben_net: SG example:
```
Egress TCP 443 -> vpce-0aa11bb22
Egress TCP 443 -> 203.0.113.10/32
Egress TCP 443 -> telemetry.redwood.net:443
```

omar_kms: For KMS: ask BlueHaven to create a symmetric CMK in their account. Key policy should grant arn:aws:iam::999111222333:role/redwood-telemetry-decrypt kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey. Rotation: yearly by default. If they want 90d, flag re-encrypt cost for archives.

sana_sec: IAM: they should create an assume-role for our aggregator with a trust policy allowing sts:AssumeRole from our account id and a Condition on aws:SourceVpc when possible. Minimum perms: s3:GetObject on telemetry prefix, kms:Decrypt on CMK, logs:PutLogEvents if using CloudWatch.

felix_eng: Note from agent side 12: our agent supports mTLS and JWT. BlueHaven uses an appliance that accepts uploaded client certs. Ask them to share upload flow and rotation cadence.

tasha_cs: BlueHaven replied: "we will upload cert; we prefer 180d rotation; WORM required for 3 years". I'll confirm legal-hold process.

ben_net: Ops suggestion: enable prefix filtering at source and sample non-critical traces 1:5 for first 72h to reduce egress/cost.

tasha_cs: Action items before cutover: (1) BlueHaven share CMK ARN, (2) create role + share ARN, (3) confirm cert upload instructions, (4) confirm S3 Object Lock settings. I'll add to runbook and validate in 09:30 PT runbook call.

runbot: (automated) Reminder: BlueHaven cutover runbook meeting 09:30 PT 12 link: https://meet.redwood/rooms/bluehaven-cutover

tasha_cs: Thanks team 14. AE: flag for renewal outreach after week1 if stable.
